FIRST LIGHT FROM THE EAST: low warm gold from one side gilding the upper curve of the vessel, the land below still cool blue with long soft shadows running away westward
FIRST LIGHT FROM THE SOUTH-EAST: early amber light catching the vessel's upper curve on one side, the ground beneath holding long cool shadows stretching far across it
FIRST LIGHT RAKING NORTH: low rose-gold from the horizon raking across the vessel's top, the land below washed in pale lavender with shadows drawn out long and soft
FIRST LIGHT FROM THE WEST: dawn gold spilling sideways onto the vessel's lit flank, the far land still deep blue-grey, long cool shadows pooling across its surface
FIRST LIGHT LOW AND WARM: golden light from just above the horizon catching the vessel's upper shoulder, the land below cool and shadowed, long warm edges glowing at every rise
LATE GOLDEN LIGHT FROM THE WEST: rich amber washing the full upper face of the vessel, the land below gilded in patches with long warm shadows reaching far eastward
LOW GOLDEN AFTERNOON LIGHT: deep gold from a low western angle catching the vessel's side and top, the ground below pooling in amber where the light reaches and cool bronze in shadow
LATE LIGHT FROM THE SOUTH-WEST: warm copper-gold raking across the vessel's upper curve, the land below lit in long low amber swaths with cool lavender shadows between them
GOLDEN HOUR DESCENT: rich warm gold from the west washing the vessel's upper and side surfaces, the ground beneath glowing orange-amber with long shadows pooling in cool violet
MID-MORNING FROM THE SOUTH-EAST: bright clear gold light from a rising angle catching the vessel sharply on one side, clean crisp shadows falling on the land below in deep rich contrast
BRIGHT MID-MORNING LIGHT: clear warm gold from the south-east striking the vessel's upper curve cleanly, the land below reading in strong saturated colour with short crisp shadows
CLEAN MID-MORNING SUN: full clear light from the south-east washing the vessel in vivid warm yellow, the land below crisp and richly coloured with clean-edged shadows
MID-MORNING FROM THE EAST: bright gold light from an angle catching the vessel's face cleanly, the land below saturated in warm colour with firm crisp shadows trailing westward
AFTERGLOW FROM BELOW: soft rose light lifting from the horizon's glow washing the vessel's underside in warm pink, the land below reading in deep muted violet
AFTERGLOW RISING: rose and amber light from beneath the horizon lifting onto the vessel's lower curve, the ground settling into deep indigo-purple tones all around
AFTERGLOW WARM AND LIFTING: warm rose-peach light from below catching the underside of the vessel in a soft upward wash, the land beneath deep plum and quietly glowing
BLUE HOUR EVEN LIGHT: soft indigo light spread evenly from all sides, the vessel pale and cool, the land below reading in deep soft silhouette against a faintly luminous ground
BLUE HOUR FROM ABOVE: even indigo washing down across the vessel in a cool flat glow, the land below a deep quiet silhouette with soft edges and rich blue tone
BLUE HOUR SETTLING: cool deep indigo light falling evenly across the vessel and the land, the ground reading as a soft dark silhouette, every form gentle and still
HIGH MOONLIGHT: cool silver light from far above, the vessel pale and softly rimmed, the land deep blue and quiet, shadows short and soft beneath every form
MOONLIGHT FROM THE SOUTH: silver light falling at a gentle angle from the south, the vessel lit pale on its upper face, the land below in deep cool blue with soft shadows
MOONLIGHT LOW FROM THE EAST: silver-white light from a low angle catching the vessel's side in a cool rim, the land below deep navy with long pale shadows stretching westward
STORM LIGHT WITH DISTANT WARMTH: dim grey-green light over most of the land, one far patch of warm amber sunlight pooling on the ground at a distance, the vessel in cool shadow
BROKEN STORM LIGHT: dim cool light falling across the vessel and most of the land, one bright warm gold patch spilling onto the far ground far below, drawing the eye outward
STORM BREAK LIGHT: the vessel sitting in cool dim light, a single warm amber glow reaching the ground far off to one side, the rest of the land in deep grey-green shadow
